instructions: Judge first submissions against the same brief and full supplied sources. Do not award points for files, logs, checklist markers or report length. Rate each dimension separately with a reason, an exact locatable excerpt and source evidence. Do not compute a weighted passing score. Prefer the report that better supports the requested decision; use tie for comparable quality and unresolved for missing evidence. Give condition clues only after choosing. Model preferences and ratings need evidence review before any efficacy interpretation.
